Dropping the token, changing its case, appending `--disable-features=DeclarativeWebmcp`, reordering, joining into a string, or changing whitespace would each give `environment`, exit 1, value 0. No defect.

2. **Selftest is missing flag mutants.** The only flags case is `flags-missing`, which removes the last element (`--disable-extensions`). A counter weakened to a substring check would still pass it. No case appends a flag, and an appended disabling flag would also pass a weaker "all expected flags present" check. Smallest red cases to add, both expecting `environment`, exit 1, value 0:
   - `flags-token-drop`: remove `,DeclarativeWebmcp` from the first flag.
   - `flags-disable-appended`: push `--disable-features=DeclarativeWebmcp`. Only exact equality catches this one.
